# Maintainers

zwasm has two roles: maintainers and contributors.

## Maintainers

| GitHub | Name |
| --- | --- |
| [@jtakakura](https://github.com/jtakakura) | Junji Takakura |
| [@chaploud](https://github.com/chaploud) | Shota Kudo |

Maintainers own the `zwasm` organization and administer this repository. They:

- review and merge pull requests. A change reaches `main` only through a pull
  request and the merge queue, after the `ci-required` check passes
  ([CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md#branch--merge-model));
- triage issues and answer Discussions;
- receive and handle vulnerability reports ([SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md));
- cut releases by hand and push the release tags
  ([docs/development.md](../docs/development.md#cutting-a-release));
- change the repository settings and the branch ruleset.

## Contributors

Anyone can open an issue, a Discussion, or a pull request
([CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)). They cannot merge, change the
repository settings, or push tags.
